context: Wrap-up of the world-history unit with the whole class
purpose: Teach: ローマ/ユダヤ/江戸/文明/階級/紛争/移民/先進

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日で世界史の単元は終わりです。古代ローマから江戸時代まで、本当によく頑張りましたね。
lines.en: Today wraps up our world-history unit. From ancient Rome to the Edo period, you've all worked really hard.
lines.style: Warm closing remark from teacher, polite desu-masu form, encouraging tone summarizing the unit

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おれが一番おもしろかったのは、ローマ帝国の階級社会の話だったな。
lines.en: What I found most interesting was the talk about the class structure in the Roman Empire.
lines.style: Casual male university student using ore, reflective and relaxed, sharing a personal favorite

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私は江戸の町人文化のところ。なんか身近に感じてよかった。
lines.en: For me it was the Edo townspeople culture section. It somehow felt close to home, which was nice.
lines.style: Teen girl casual register, short sentences, slightly informal nanka filler, personal reaction

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ユダヤの人々の歴史や、世界各地の文明の発展も学びましたね。
lines.en: We also studied the history of the Jewish people and the development of civilizations around the world.
lines.style: Teacher politely listing covered topics, measured pace, reinforcing curriculum breadth

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現代の紛争のニュースを見るたびに、歴史の授業を思い出すんだよね。
lines.en: Every time I see news about modern conflicts, I find myself thinking back to history class.
lines.style: Ren reflective casual speech, connecting past learning to current events, thoughtful

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 移民の問題も結局は昔から続いてるって先生言ってましたよね。
lines.en: You said immigration issues have basically been going on since long ago too, right sensei?
lines.style: Teen addressing teacher with light deshita-yo-ne, half casual half respectful, citing earlier lesson

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。先進国と呼ばれる国々の課題も、根っこは歴史の中にあります。
lines.en: That's right. Even the challenges facing so-called developed nations are rooted in history.
lines.style: Teacher affirming student, polite explanatory tone, drawing broader lesson with reflective closing

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 来週のテスト、やばい。これから図書館で復習してくる。
lines.en: Next week's test is rough. I'm heading to the library to review now.
lines.style: Ren shifting to playful worry, casual yabai slang, transitional outro line announcing departure
